user_query: My company is organizing a workshop on climate change and we need to gather news articles and statistics to present to the attendees. Can you provide us with climate change news from various newspapers? Additionally, we want to extract the main article and metadata from a news entry or blog post. Furthermore, we need to know the gender distribution and nationalities of the workshop participants.

TaskList.description: Gather news articles related to climate change from various online newspapers and news outlets.
Extract the main content and metadata from the gathered news articles or blog posts.
Collect demographic information regarding the workshop participants, including gender distribution and nationalities.
